Templates ​

List and retrieve reusable generation presets.

List templates​

GET
/templates

Returns the authenticated user's own templates plus all public
templates. Public templates have user_id: null and are
system-provided starting points that any user can run directly.

Authorizations​

apiKeyAuth

API key (sk_live_... or sk_test_...) obtained from the dashboard

Type
HTTP (bearer)
or
jwtAuth

JWT token obtained from /auth/login

Type
HTTP (bearer)

Parameters​

Query Parameters

s

Search query — filters by name (partial match), or if the value is a valid template UUID, returns an exact match by template ID

Type
string
Max Length
255
ownership

Filter by ownership (all = user's + public, public = system templates only, private = user's only)

Type
string
Valid values
"all""public""private"
Default
"all"
model_id

Filter by AI model ID

Type
integer
sort_by

Sort field

Type
string
Valid values
"created_at""name"
Default
"created_at"
sort_direction

Sort direction

Type
string
Valid values
"asc""desc"
Default
"desc"
page

Page number

Type
integer
Minimum
1
Default
1
per_page

Items per page

Type
integer
Minimum
1
Maximum
100
Default
15

Get template​

GET
/templates/{template}

Returns a single template. Accessible if the template is owned
by the authenticated user or is public.

Authorizations​

apiKeyAuth

API key (sk_live_... or sk_test_...) obtained from the dashboard

Type
HTTP (bearer)
or
jwtAuth

JWT token obtained from /auth/login

Type
HTTP (bearer)

Parameters​

Path Parameters

template*

Template UUID

Type
string
Required
Format
"uuid"
